sources.title: VikramPal/Muse-Glimmer-30B-hermes-funcall-DynQuant-4bit · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The fine-tune is worth +27.33 points over the base model. 4-bit retains +21.22 of that -- 78% of the gain -- at 3.99x compression. The 6.10-point gap to bf16 is statistically real rather than a tie: 28 items lost against 7 gained.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer - Meta
sources.snippet: An open 30B model for always-on local agents. Runs on a single GPU, Apache 2.0 licensed. Tuned for tool use, long tasks, and failure recovery.

sources.title: meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Overview Muse Glimmer 30B is a dense vision-language model built for agentic work on consumer hardware: a 52-layer text decoder (hidden 6656) plus a ~1.8B ViT-G/14 perception encoder, 128K trained context, BF16. Apache 2.0, knowledge cutoff January 4 2026, trained on 100+ languages. What makes it unlike most recipes here is its output format.

sources.title: muse-glimmer:30b - ollama.com
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer is a 30-billion-parameter causal language model with a dedicated perception encoder, distilled from Muse Spark and purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware.
